scope: Execute the miniport binary with modeled video-port calls and NV2A registers.

tests.test: Native 80-byte W2K initialization and required callbacks with stdcall ABI
Firmware NV2A mode is decoded into the native 32-bit RGB descriptor
One firmware mode is enumerated with correct output sizes
Mode zero accepts documented mapping flags and rejects unsupported modes
Framebuffer mapping uses the reserved GPU aperture and bounds the visible surface
Short buffers and unsupported controls return explicit errors
Invalid firmware mode or unreserved framebuffer fails and releases the register mapping
VideoPort mapping failure propagates without publishing a bogus framebuffer
